Great food, great service.
Oct 2024 • Couples
This is one the best restaurants we have been to. From the time we arrived, we were welcomed by staff and the owner. Chow !!! We ordered our meal and drinks and our first delight arrived at our table served in a glass case. Not only delicious, it was lovely and elegant to look at. This was followed by our entrée of sashimi. So tasteful, it melted in your mouth. My husband is not into raw fish but he ate this without any problem at all. Being true blue Kiwi, he had the steak from New Zealand while I had the hamburger. Honestly, both dishes were tender and so tasty. Once we finished, we headed down stairs to pay. The owner came to farewell us sending us on our way with a small gift. A fantastic experience with great food and great hospitality. We hope to return before we leave Ho Chi MInh City.

A paradise for steak lovers!
Feb 2022
I have been living in HCMC for 15 years and so far they have the best steaks i've had and I have been to many other steakhouses before. From the moment you are being greeted by the staff, you can feel the very attentive and professional Japanese hospitality. About the food? It simply always hits the spot, Beef tongue, wagyu beef, tomahawk, you name it, they nail it. IL Corda is always a great choice for a business lunch/dinner or a romantic dinner. +50 points for their private room which is ideal for private business dinners. Well done guys!
